title: olea cassinifolia
intro: Olea cassinifolia, commonly known as the St. John's olive or the Wild olive tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Olea cassinifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Olea cassinifolia include oleuropein, hydroxytyrosol, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
